root_cause: The targeted website browser gate treated a transient Netlify deploy-preview cold-start navigation timeout as a functional route regression. The preview later became reachable, so a single 45-second page.goto attempt was too brittle for provider startup variance.
prevention_rule: Targeted browser verification may retry only Playwright TimeoutError navigation failures, with a bounded maximum of three attempts and short backoff. Any non-timeout error or any content, identity, asset, or page-error regression remains fail-closed.

evidence.observed_failure: GitHub Required run 35730876000 timed out on the first navigation to deploy-preview-2609 while preceding static and exact-artifact checks were green.
evidence.production_readback: Pending rerun, protected merge, exact production identity and pricing content proof.
